rule: Between undertakings the creditor is entitled to interest for late payment without the necessity of a reminder.
key_sentence: without the necessity of a reminder

rule: A period fixed in the contract may not exceed 60 calendar days unless expressly agreed and not grossly unfair to the creditor.
key_sentence: the period for payment fixed in the contract does not exceed 60 calendar days, unless otherwise expressly agreed in the contract and provided it is not grossly unfair to the creditor within the meaning of Article 7.

rule: An acceptance or verification procedure may not exceed 30 calendar days unless expressly agreed and not grossly unfair to the creditor.
key_sentence: does not exceed 30 calendar days from the date of receipt of the goods or services, unless otherwise expressly agreed in the contract and provided it is not grossly unfair to the creditor within the meaning of Article 7.

rule: The creditor is entitled to a fixed sum of EUR 40 as a minimum for recovery costs.
key_sentence: the creditor is entitled to obtain from the debtor, as a minimum, a fixed sum of EUR 40

rule: A term excluding interest for late payment is considered grossly unfair.
key_sentence: shall be considered as grossly unfair

rule: Member States may keep or adopt provisions more favourable to the creditor.
key_sentence: Member States may maintain or bring into force provisions which are more favourable to the creditor than the provisions necessary to comply with this Directive.

rule: For building work, posted workers can hold the contractor of which their employer is a direct subcontractor liable, or equivalent enforcement measures apply.
key_sentence: posted workers can hold the contractor of which the employer is a direct subcontractor liable

rule: On a site where more than one contractor is present, the client or project supervisor appoints safety and health coordinators.
key_sentence: for any construction site on which more than one contractor is present

rule: Employers take into account the directions of the safety and health coordinator.
key_sentence: take into account directions from the coordinator(s)

rule: An electronic signature is not denied legal effect or admissibility as evidence solely because it is electronic.
key_sentence: shall not be denied legal effect and admissibility as evidence in legal proceedings solely on the grounds that it is in an electronic form

rule: A qualified electronic signature has the equivalent legal effect of a handwritten signature.
key_sentence: A qualified electronic signature shall have the equivalent legal effect of a handwritten signature.

rule: Form requirements for contracts remain national law.
key_sentence: This Regulation does not affect Union or national law related to the conclusion and validity of contracts

rule: Companies must be registered in the Registro de Empresas Acreditadas to be contracted or subcontracted for construction works.
key_sentence: Estar inscritas en el Registro de Empresas Acreditadas al que se refiere el artículo 6 de esta Ley.

rule: REA data are publicly accessible and the registration is valid nationwide.
key_sentence: siendo sus datos de acceso público con la salvedad de los referentes a la intimidad de las personas

rule: A third-tier subcontractor cannot subcontract further.
key_sentence: El tercer subcontratista no podrá subcontratar los trabajos que hubiera contratado con otro subcontratista o trabajador autónomo.

rule: An autónomo cannot subcontract the work entrusted to them.
key_sentence: El trabajador autónomo no podrá subcontratar los trabajos a él encomendados ni a otras empresas subcontratistas ni a otros trabajadores autónomos.

rule: Subcontractors whose productive organisation is essentially labour only cannot subcontract.
key_sentence: cuya organización productiva puesta en uso en la obra consista fundamentalmente en la aportación de mano de obra

rule: One exceptional extra tier needs the dirección facultativa's prior approval and cause entered in the Libro de Subcontratación; not available for autónomos or labour-only subcontractors except force majeure.
key_sentence: siempre que se haga constar por la dirección facultativa su aprobación previa y la causa o causas motivadoras de la misma en el Libro de Subcontratación

rule: The contractor must report an exceptional subcontracting to the labour authority within 5 working days of approval with a report and a copy of the Libro entry.
key_sentence: en el plazo de los cinco días hábiles siguientes a su aprobación

rule: Contractors and subcontractors must supervise compliance by those they contract and are jointly liable for labour and Social Security obligations when REA or tier rules are breached.
key_sentence: determinará la responsabilidad solidaria del subcontratista que hubiera contratado incurriendo en dichos incumplimientos y del correspondiente contratista

rule: Each contractor must hold a Libro de Subcontratación kept on site (out of scope for Formify, describe only).
key_sentence: cada contratista deberá disponer de un Libro de Subcontratación

rule: Companies must be entered in the REA before intervening in subcontracting; validity is three years, renewable.
key_sentence: Las empresas que pretendan ser contratadas o subcontratadas para trabajos en una obra de construcción deberán estar inscritas en el Registro de Empresas Acreditadas.

rule: An REA certificate obtained by the contracting company discharges its duty of supervision for one works and the contract term; it must be requested within the month before execution and is issued within 10 natural days.
key_sentence: deberá haber sido solicitada dentro del mes anterior al inicio de la ejecución del contrato

rule: Principal contractors must obtain a negative Social Security debt certificate in writing; the TGSS must issue it within 30 days; joint liability runs 3 years (Social Security) and 1 year (wages); not applicable to a person contracting works on their own dwelling.
key_sentence: recabarán por escrito, con identificación de la empresa afectada, certificación negativa por descubiertos en la Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social

rule: The payer of a subcontractor is not subsidiarily liable for the subcontractor's tax debts if it holds the AEAT certificate of being up to date, issued within the previous 12 months before each invoice payment.
key_sentence: emitido a estos efectos por la Administración tributaria durante los 12 meses anteriores al pago de cada factura

rule: Payment terms between businesses, including contractors with their suppliers and subcontractors, may be extended by agreement but never beyond 60 natural days.
key_sentence: sin que, en ningún caso, se pueda acordar un plazo superior a 60 días naturales

rule: Ley 3/2004 covers contractor payments to suppliers and subcontractors and excludes payments in transactions involving consumers.
key_sentence: Los pagos efectuados en las operaciones comerciales en las que intervengan consumidores.
